title: Sent to SRI to assess the Gondola Wish project, then assigned to it

tellings.quote: he found out that he had a think this thing called Gondola wish starting at Fort me and he was nervous about it

plain: In 1978, according to Joe McMoneagle, who was part of it, a general named Roya learned that an Army project code-named Gondola Wish was starting at Fort Meade and was nervous about it. McMoneagle tells Michels he was sent to the Stanford Research Institute, a California research lab, to assess the work, and then ended up assigned to the project himself.
